# Leadership Learners

Leadership Learners provides leadership training for managers and teams, communication coaching for individuals, and DISC assessments. Tammy Summers leads the training and coaching.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/): Overview of services and ways to contact Tammy.
- [Corporate leadership training](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/corporate): Group training and organizational DISC assessments.
- [Individual communication coaching](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/individual): One-to-one coaching and individual DISC assessments.
- [About Tammy Summers](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/about): Background and approach.
- [Blog](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/blog): Articles on leadership, communication, and related topics.
- [Contact](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/contact): Phone and email contact options.
